name: 3WART Content Performance Heatmap Light
author: 3wartge

sections.description:
3WART Content Performance Heatmap Light allows you to see exactly which parts of your website are attracting attention from your visitors.
It captures clicks, mouse movements, and scroll activity, and visualizes the data on a heatmap overlay within the WordPress admin dashboard.

This is the Light version, providing the essential tracking features without advanced analytics, WooCommerce integration, or attention scoring.

Key Features

  • Track and visualize user clicks on posts and pages
  • Record mouse movements to understand visitor behavior
  • Capture scroll depth for each page
  • Lightweight and easy to use
  • GDPR-friendly (no personal data collected)
  • Compatible with the latest WordPress versions

Looking to customize even further or expand capabilities?

A Pro version with extended functionality is available here: https://shop.3wart.ge/product/3wart-content-performance-heatmap-pro

External services

This plugin does not require or use any external services. All data is stored locally in your WordPress database.

Upgrade for More

Want additional functionality, more customization options, and priority support?

Check out the Pro version at:
https://shop.3wart.ge/product/3wart-content-performance-heatmap-pro

Features in Pro include:
* WooCommerce product heatmaps
* Weighted Attention Score
* Session filtering and device breakdown
* Behavioral triggers and UX analytics
* Export to Excel and PDF
sections.installation:
1. Upload the 3wart-content-performance-heatmap-light folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the 3WART Heatmap admin menu to start visualizing data.
  4. Heatmaps will automatically start recording on all posts and pages.
sections.faq:
Does it work on WooCommerce products?

No, WooCommerce product tracking is only available in the Pro version.

Can I export the heatmap data?

Not in the Light version. Data can be viewed only inside the WordPress admin.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. This plugin only records anonymous interaction data and does not store any personal information.
